nodes.name: Paul Cassell
nodes.note: University of Utah law professor and former federal judge. With Bradley Edwards, represented Courtney Wild in the Crime Victims' Rights Act case against the 2008 deal, from the district court to the en banc Eleventh Circuit (lost 7-4, 2021) and a Supreme Court petition (Sept 2021).

nodes.name: Courtney Wild
nodes.note: Survivor. The "Jane Doe" whose Crime Victims' Rights Act petition (filed 7 Jul 2008) argued that the victims were kept in the dark about the deal; the district court agreed in 2019. Spoke at the 27 Aug 2019 hearing after Epstein's death.

nodes.name: Maurene Comey
nodes.note: SDNY prosecutor for about ten years; worked on the Epstein (2019) and Maxwell cases. Fired in July 2025 without a stated reason. On 26 Oct 2026 Judge Jesse Furman ruled the firing unlawful (due process) and ordered back pay; the DOJ says it will appeal.

nodes.name: US Supreme Court
nodes.note: Declined to hear Maxwell's appeal on 6 Oct 2025, leaving her conviction in place; she had argued the 2007 deal's co-conspirator clause protected her. Earlier declined the victims' Crime Victims' Rights Act petition (In re Wild).
